paper_title: Weak nuclear decays deep-underground as a probe of axion dark matter
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1 exactly as plotted on the y-axis (inverse axion decay constant, axion-gluon coupling plane); NOT converted to f_a or m_a
notes: Paper recasts underground LNGS gamma-spectroscopy data on 40K electron-capture decay (2015-2017) and 137Cs beta decay (2011-2012) time-modulation limits into constraints on the axion-gluon coupling in the (m_a, 1/f_a) plane. Main measured result (2-sigma): axion decay constants f_a below 1.0e14 GeV (at m_a = 3.0e-23 eV) down to 3.2e10 GeV (at m_a = 9.6e-20 eV) are excluded; the f_a bound scales as ~1/m_a between these endpoints (I(t) ~ 1/(m_a^2 f_a^2)), so log-linear interpolation between the two points reproduces the exclusion curve. Assumes local DM density rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 with theta(t) = theta_0 cos(m_a t). The paper also proposes a future 40K EC measurement reaching up to m_a ~ 1e-9 eV (projection, not included in data_points).
